'''Chomper''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Hive}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Chomper}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Clamp
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage ×2.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Screech
|Intent = StatusCard
|Effect = Shuffles 3 {{C2|Dazed}} into your discard pile.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Chompers always appear in pairs. One opens with {{Int2|Chomper|Clamp}} and the other opens with {{Int2|Chomper|Screech}}. After that, each one alternates between {{Int2|Chomper|Clamp}} and {{Int2|Chomper|Screech}} every turn.

== Trivia ==
* '''Chompers''' are similar to the {{M|Sentry}} [[Elites|Elite]] from ''Slay the Spire'':
** They both alternate between attacking and creating {{C|Dazed}} in the discard pile each turn.
** They both have {{BD2|Artifact}}.
** Both fights feature multiple of that enemy.
* '''Chompers''' will actually say "Screech" with a speech bubble whenever they use {{Int2|Chomper|Screech}}.
** However, the speech bubble is immediately obscured by the three {{C2|Dazed}} appearing (especially when Fast Mode is enabled).
